title: Business overview
description: Fixed SQL, no AI calls, so this view always works. Revenue follows the glossary: delivered and shipped orders only.

year.label: Year
year.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS y FROM orders ORDER BY y

tiles.title: Key figures
tiles.caption: Delivered/shipped orders. With a year selected, arrows compare with the previous year.
tiles.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS "Revenue", COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Orders", COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS "Customers", ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS "Avg order value" FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year)

tiles.title: Revenue by month
tiles.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

tiles.title: Revenue by category
tiles.sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Top 10 products
tiles.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

tiles.title: Revenue by customer country
tiles.sql: SELECT cu.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY cu.country ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Revenue by sales region
tiles.sql: SELECT e.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY e.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

tiles.title: Orders by status
tiles.caption: All orders, including cancelled and returned.
tiles.sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = :year) GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY orders DESC

tiles.title: Average rating by category
tiles.caption: Reviews written in the selected year.
tiles.sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE (:year IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', r.review_date) = :year) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
